name: Len Miller

tenures.source: PAW Tuesday Night Aftermath, Part 1/2, 22 April 1997.

caption: Won the PAW's first-ever match by pinfall over Jobber the Mutt with a top-rope Millersault, his manager Orren Macklin at ringside.

name: Jobber the Mutt

tenures.source: PAW Tuesday Night Aftermath, Part 1/2, 22 April 1997.

caption: A 502-pound heel jobber who no-sold three dropkicks before falling to Len Miller's Millersault in the fed's opening match.

name: Robbie Greer

tenures.source: PAW Tuesday Night Aftermath, Part 1/2, 22 April 1997.

caption: A former World and Intercontinental Champion elsewhere who beat the Republican-gimmicked Job Dole with a Crash Landing on the fed's first card, valeted by Jenny Shards.

name: Job Dole

tenures.source: PAW Tuesday Night Aftermath, Part 1/2, 22 April 1997.

caption: A 73-year-old politician-gimmick wrestler, accompanied by his wife/valet Elizajob Dole, beaten by Robbie Greer on the fed's first card.

name: Marc Stevens

tenures.source: PAW Tuesday Night Aftermath, Part 2/2, 22 April 1997.

caption: Handled by the fed's own founder before the fed's launch (per its founding post); lost the fed's first main event to Rock Ramon by submission, then blindsided him after the bell.

name: Rock Ramon

tenures.source: PAW Tuesday Night Aftermath, Part 2/2, 22 April 1997.

caption: A gold-draped member of the Street Gang stable, managed by 'Fabulous' Frank Friday, who won the fed's first main event over Marc Stevens with an STF.

name: Dimento

tenures.source: PAW Tuesday Night Aftermath, Part 1/2, 22 April 1997.

caption: One half of the Darknight Express, reminiscing on-camera about a prior tag title run in the UWF before declaring designs on the PAW Tag Team Championship.

name: Demolition

tenures.source: PAW Tuesday Night Aftermath, Part 1/2, 22 April 1997.

caption: One half of the Darknight Express, declared on-camera the toughest team in the world alongside his partner Dimento.

identity.note: The same billing exists in other wings; this entity was minted from its own federation's 1997 documents with no receipt joining it to those — held distinct under the no-auto-merge-and-no-silent-distinctness rule; reopenable on a shared-handler or cross-fed receipt.
